seo.title: ODDference 2027 | Creativity, Business & Society
seo.description: Where creative expertise meets business and society. ODDference brings creative practitioners, business leaders and decision-makers together at Tanssin talo, Helsinki, on 22–23 April 2027.

title: Where creative expertise meets business and society.

concept.headline: What can business and wider society learn from creative expertise?
concept.body:
Creativity shapes what people notice, desire, remember and care about. Yet creative expertise is still too often treated as decoration, entertainment or inspiration — brought in after the important decisions have already been made.

ODDference starts from a different premise. For two days at Tanssin talo, creative practitioners bring that expertise into the same room as leaders from business and wider society — exploring what imagination, taste, cultural relevance and experimentation can teach us.

reasons.title: How do you build something people genuinely care about?
reasons.body: Attention is easy to chase and hard to earn. We’ll explore how brands, artists and cultural makers create meaning, distinction and relevance that people choose to notice and remember.

reasons.title: How do you create something people want to join — and contribute to?
reasons.body: What makes people join, contribute and stay involved? We’ll look at what communities, games, culture and creative practice can teach us about participation and belonging.

reasons.title: How do you imagine and create what does not yet exist?
reasons.body: When familiar answers stop working, how do you imagine something new that people will genuinely want? We’ll explore how creative practitioners experiment, challenge assumptions and develop ideas before the outcome is clear.

partnershipCta.title: What could your organisation bring to ODDference?
partnershipCta.body: Bring an idea, expertise, resources or a question worth exploring with the people in the room. The best partnerships make the event better for the people taking part — not just add another logo to the wall.
